verdict.rationale: GA4's own docs say the Data API v1 includes funnel reporting, and a community user notes you can build custom reports in 'Explore'. Neither shows a founder-friendly, no-code funnel view with step-by-step drop-off, and several hands-on users describe the interface as complex and aimed at data scientists, which undercuts the 'without an analyst' part. Missing for 10: documented UI funnel exploration with per-step drop-off, evidence a non-analyst can run it self-serve, activation-step configuration details, and independent hands-on corroboration of funnel analysis.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer "which activation step loses users?" myself with funnels and drop-off analysis, without an analyst

citations.quote: Data API v1'de ayrıca özel anlık raporlama ve dönüşüm hunisi raporlama özellikleri de bulunur.
